plan.title: Pendulum to Tumbling Tower

items.name: Pendulum
items.why: Stage 1: pulled 25° to the left and let go at the release, it swings right and strikes the cue ball

items.name: Flat shelf
items.why: A level shelf, so the cue ball waits at the pendulum's lowest point without rolling away

items.name: Cue ball
items.why: Struck by the pendulum bob, it rolls right along the shelf

items.name: Ramp
items.why: Stage 2: it starts just below the shelf's end, so the ball drops onto it, speeds up and reaches the table at about 1.8 m/s

items.name: Growing dominoes
items.why: Stage 3: nine dominoes, each 1.25× the last, from 6 cm up to about 36 cm tall, so the wave gains energy

items.name: Tower block 6
items.why: Top of the 30 cm tower; the big last domino falls onto its upper blocks

goals.label: The pendulum strikes the cue ball
The top of the tower comes crashing down

plan.notes: Four stages: (1) a pendulum swings down and knocks the cue ball off its shelf; (2) the ball drops onto a ramp, rolls down and crosses the table; (3) it starts a row of growing dominoes; (4) the last 36 cm domino topples a six-block tower as the finale.
assumptions: Open request: I chose a pendulum, a ramp, growing dominoes and a block tower as four different stages, laid out left to right.
The pendulum hits the ball at about 1 m/s, so the ball drops gently onto the ramp instead of flying over it.
The first domino is 6 cm tall, so the 5.7 cm ball hits it near half its height and tips it rather than pushing it along.
The shelf and ramp stand on their wooden legs.
